# Slider

A Settings slider with the current value, its default marked as a tick, "Reset to default", and a hatched range it can't enter.

`CLR.Slider` · Controls

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Slider label="…" value={0} min={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Slider" label="…" value="{{0}}" min="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (SliderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `value` * | `number` |  |
| `min` * | `number` |  |
| `max` * | `number` |  |
| `step` | `number` |  |
| `unit` * | `string` |  |
| `defaultValue` * | `number` | Default value: drawn as a tick, and "Reset to default" appears when value differs. |
| `blockBelow` | `number` | Values below this are hatched and unreachable (fatigue must exceed high load). |
| `help` | `string` |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number) => void` |  |
| `onReset` | `() => void` |  |
